text: Custom roster entry: {id, role:'custom', name, harness, model, effort, args, instructions, does, lead:false}. roster(stored, known) returns the six roles then customs in saved order; names that clash (slug) with a role name, alias or earlier agent get ' 2', ' 3'. blank() returns does:''. Settings adds with save([...list, blank(list, known)]) and removes with save(list.filter(a => a.id !== id)); only role 'custom' is removable or renamable. Custom agents edit files (worktree + worker role) like Dev.
